name: manual_ace144
claim: Before replaying an old commit onto rewritten main, check whether main removed that behavior on purpose (git log -S for the symbol, git grep on main); a deliberate security removal supersedes the old commit and must not be reintroduced.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: a pre-scrub portal commit embedded a bearer token in served HTML for loopback requests. Main removed it in the 2026-06-28 auth-hardening commit and the helper now states it never embeds bearer tokens in HTML; replaying would have reverted a security fix.
